config._comment: Skill system v2 (skill-system spec 00-10). 20 skills/class: ranks 1-10 = original v1 set, 11-20 = Phase 9d expansion (requiredLevel 22-60). Save IDs of classes never change; advancement stays display-only.

bossResist._comment: Phase 9c (skill doc 08): each repeat status on a boss is 35% shorter, floor 15%; resets after 22s clean; elites resist at half rate.
